changelog: A reply you drafted and never sent is brought back, and the rule that nothing goes without you is held more tightly by code.
features: A reply you prepared and never sent or dropped, while the other person is still waiting, is brought back once: "your reply to @handle is drafted but not sent · want to see it again?". It never sends anything by itself
A message you already saw and have not answered now reads "still waiting since yesterday" instead of looking new
A draft shown in an earlier conversation must be shown again before it can be sent. Re-showing a draft always needs a fresh typed message from you before it goes
Only a message you typed counts as your turn. A report from a subagent, a message from another session or a background notice no longer does
A pick in a question menu does not count as your choice; the agent shows the preview and asks in words
A message or link carrying characters that do not show, long runs of blank lines, or a look-alike handle is refused when it is prepared. Ordinary emoji and scripts that need joiners still work
An untouched older /vibe command file is updated when the server starts; one you edited is left alone
Known gap, stated in SECURITY.md: a wake-up the agent schedules for itself still counts as your turn
